correctness.rationale: Five exact Euclidean shells exhaust all 66 pairs. Every one of 126 explicit free-face deletions is replayed and checked from full stage face sets. First two reduced complexes are cycles; the angular integer cocycle proves the intervening persistence map has degree ±1. Third stage collapses to a 2-complex with χ=4 and is simply connected by a surjection-on-π1 and a four-triangle filling, giving a wedge of three 2-spheres. Fourth stage is exactly Ind(C12), whose known homotopy type is two 3-spheres. Final stage is a simplex. All integral interval maps follow. Standalone mod-two boundary calculations corroborate, but do not substitute for, these arguments.
